create_ModelEnv: create a ModelEnv instance wrapping a dynamics model with a termination function and gym environment
reset_ModelEnv: reset the ModelEnv with a batch of initial observations to start parallel episodes
step_ModelEnv: step the ModelEnv forward with a batch of actions and get next observations and rewards
evaluate_action_sequences_ModelEnv: evaluate a batch of action sequences on the model using particle-based Monte Carlo rollouts
review_ModelEnv_class: review the ModelEnv class that wraps a dynamics model into a gym-like environment for MBRL
